name: Bass, Dist 2
description: 4 to 1 with Dist 2: a second harmonic that grows with the reduction, warmth on the loud notes.

name: Drums, Dist 3
description: 6 to 1, a quick attack and release, and Dist 3: the clipping stage driven hard, a snare's crack with a third harmonic's grit on it.

name: Opto, Smooth
description: 10 to 1, the soft optical kind, a slower attack and release: guitars and keys levelled without the fronts lost.

name: Room, Nuke
description: Nuke at the fastest attack, the detector's high-pass in: room microphones flattened so the room swells up between the hits. Blend it in under the kit.

name: Vocal, De-Ess
description: 6 to 1 with the band emphasis: the detector hears the esses loudest, so it turns them down most.

name: Vocal, Rock
description: 3 to 1 with the detector's high-pass in, a medium attack and release: a lead vocal held level and brought forward. Turn the input up until the meter moves 4 to 8 dB on the loud lines.
